issues.title: Greet the developer by name
issues.body: The welcome line says "Hello" to nobody. It should use the developer's name when Fern knows it.

prs.title: Add a clamp helper
prs.author: fern-dev
prs.head: fern-dev/clamp
prs.body: Adds `clamp`, which the slider in #42 needs.

prs.title: Clamp the font size slider
prs.author: fern-dev
prs.head: fern-dev/font-size
prs.body: The slider let the font size go to 0. Now it stays between 10 and 24.

prs.title: Remember the font size across launches
prs.author: fern-dev
prs.head: fern-dev/font-size-saved
prs.body: Saves the font size with the window's other settings.

prs.title: Retry a failed fetch once
prs.author: mira-k
prs.head: mira-k/retry
prs.body: A flaky network made the Pull requests page fail on the first try. This retries once before giving up.

prs.title: Wait before the retry
prs.author: mira-k
prs.head: mira-k/retry-wait
prs.body: Waits 200 ms before retrying, so a blip has time to pass.

edits.append: Fern greets you by name once it knows it.

prs.title: Fix a typo in the README
prs.author: fern-dev
prs.head: fern-dev/readme-typo

prs.title: Log how long each request takes
prs.author: devon-r
prs.head: devon-r/request-timing
prs.body: Logs each request's duration at debug level.

prs.title: Rename the settings file
prs.author: mira-k
prs.head: mira-k/settings-name
prs.body: Renames it to match the others.

prs.title: Try a dark splash screen
prs.author: devon-r
prs.head: devon-r/dark-splash
prs.body: An experiment; closing in favour of the theme work.
